answer: In an attestation graph, trust propagates through bounded-length random walks from independently anchored participants, limiting how far influence can travel. A Sybil cluster with few links to the honest region has low conductance: its sparse external cut restricts walk flow into the cluster and, with capped per-node voting and anchor-based normalization, bounds its aggregate voting weight. Names such as gale, lotus, and sonnet do not affect this cut-based guarantee.
